def min_time_to_cross(n, s, e, x, a, b, c, d):
    # Initialize a DP array where dp[i][j] represents the minimum time to reach chair j while visiting chair i
    dp = [[float('inf')] * n for _ in range(n)]
    dp[0][s-1] = 0  # Scott starts at position s

    for i in range(1, n):
        for j in range(n):
            # Scott can only jump from chair i-1 to chair i
            if i == j:
                continue

            # Scott can jump from chair k to chair i
            for k in range(i):
                cost = 0
                if j < k:
                    cost = abs(x[j] - x[k]) + c[j] + b[k]
                else:
                    cost = abs(x[j] - x[k]) + d[j] + a[k]

                # Scott's size depends on the direction of the jump
                if j < k:
                    dp[i][j] = min(dp[i][j], dp[i-1][k] + cost)
                else:
                    dp[i][j] = min(dp[i][j], dp[i-1][k] + cost)

    # The result is the minimum time to reach chair e while visiting all chairs
    return min(dp[n-1][e-1], dp[n-1][s-1] + abs(x[e-1] - x[s-1]) + c[e-1] + b[s-1])

# Read input
n, s, e = map(int, input().split())

c = list(map(int, input().split()))
d = list(map(int, input().split()))

# Calculate and print the result
